description: Straßen ATKIS is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. road sections from ATKIS; Viewing object in GDZ, multi-feature class consists of the linear feature class GDZ2010.L brstrabs and the spatial feature class GDZ2010.A brstrabs (currently not filled) and the corresponding business class GDZ2010.brstrabs, exported to the filegeodatabase GDZ GDB.gdb The following user-relevant attributes are available: OIDALK = ATKIS objectid OBJBEZ = object name STAFK ... Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Roads ATKIS" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Saarland, Verkehrswesen, GEOBASIS_Strassen_ATKIS. The listing shows 2010-08-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
